title: Integrated single-cell transcriptomics and machine learning identify macrophage RPS26 as a potential biomarker for atrial fibrillation.
snippet: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most prevalent arrhythmia worldwide, with its incidence and burden rising steeply with advancing age. However, the pathological process of AF remains incompletely understood, and the discovery of reliable biomarkers to guide gene and cell therapy remains challenging in precision medicine.
